recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if CDS later approves a DetectedIssue binding change or a future terminology cleanup intentionally retires manifestation-or-symptom across current build artifacts.
issue_request: FHIR-32755 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care clarification request to change Condition.evidence.code from the Manifestation and Symptom Codes value set to valueset-clinical-findings, while noting that DetectedIssue would require a separate CDS-owned Jira.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit c8887e6add14858f6bfbb320d0d54e02a74f868d, which changed the Condition evidence binding valueSet from http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/manifestation-or-symptom to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/clinical-findings and added a J#32755 committee note. FHIR-32481 had already refactored Condition.evidence.code/detail into the current CodeableReference-based Condition.evidence element.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Condition and DetectedIssue as active resources. Current Condition source uses clinical-findings on Condition.evidence; DetectedIssue.evidence.code still uses manifestation-or-symptom, which matches FHIR-32755's explicit note that DetectedIssue was outside the Patient Care decision and needed separate CDS agreement. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence checks found no conflicting community or later source decision expanding FHIR-32755 beyond Condition.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already satisfies the approved Condition binding change after the R5 Condition.evidence refactor, and changing DetectedIssue would exceed the issue's approved scope.
